questions.question: What film does Marcin accidentally come across?
answers: About the Battle of Berestechko and Wiśniowiecki
questions.explanation: He comes across a film about Berestechko and Wiśniowiecki.

questions.question: What does the old man in Berestechko say about the charge?
questions.explanation: He says: three hours, son — and everything changed.

questions.question: Why did Wiśniowiecki move east instead of fleeing?
answers: Because without resistance the rebellion would have destroyed everything
Because he was looking for treasure
questions.explanation: Marcin writes that he moved into the fire because the rebellion had to be stopped.

questions.question: How old was Wiśniowiecki when he died, according to the epilogue?
questions.explanation: The epilogue: he died at the age of 39.

questions.question: What does Marcin write at the end of the article about the conditional mood of history?
answers: That history always repeats its mistakes
That history doesn't know the conditional mood
That the past can be changed
questions.explanation: He quotes: history doesn't know the conditional mood.
